C0.quote: Sortition is based on the idea of choosing randomly selected representatives
C0.note: Main object is sortition: a random selection algorithm that 'takes as input the metric d and outputs a distribution over all panels' built from demographic features; individuals submit no ballots or votes and nothing is aggregated by voting. The paper notes panel selection 'can be framed as a committee election problem' (Section 1.3), but the studied procedure is random sampling for representation, not voting. Coding stopped per C0.
